abstract:
BACKGROUND: Diabetes is a known risk factor, and a distinct form termed pancreatic cancer-related diabetes (PCRD) often precedes the diagnosis of cancer by 3-5 years, offering a potential window for intervention. We hypothesised that interactions between stromal pancreatic stellate cells (PSCs) and cancer cells trigger secretion of exosomal factors that impair islet function and insulin signalling, contributing to PCRD pathogenesis.
METHODS: KC (KrasLSL-G12D/+; Pdx1-Cre) mice were fed a high-fructose diet (HFrD) or control diet for 16 weeks. Exosomes were isolated from monocultures and co-cultures of cancer/PanIN cells with PSCs, characterised by nanoparticle tracking analysis and transmission electron microscopy, and incubated with mouse β-cells (MIN6) and peripheral cells (hepatocytes, adipocytes, skeletal myocytes). Effects on insulin secretion and insulin-signalling factors were examined. Exosomal glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) expression was modulated by siRNA to assess functional impact.
RESULTS: HFrD induced marked glucose intolerance in KC mice and was accompanied by enhanced PSC activation, macrophage infiltration, inflammation, and accelerated PanIN progression. Exosomes from PSCs, cancer cells, and co-cultures displayed typical morphology and marker expression and were efficiently internalised by β-cells and hepatocytes. Functionally, exosomes significantly impaired glucose-stimulated insulin secretion in mouse and human β-cells without altering insulin content. In hepatocytes, PSC-, cancer-, and co-culture-derived exosomes reduced key insulin-signalling components, including IR, IRS, AKT, FOXO1 and GLUT2, and inhibited glucose uptake. Silencing exosomal G6PD partially restored hepatocyte insulin signalling.
CONCLUSION: This study identifies a potential contributor to PCRD and suggests a possible mechanistic role for exosomal G6PD in impaired insulin signalling associated with PCRD.
key_points_ko: 췌장암 관련 당뇨병은 통상 췌장암 진단보다 3~5년 앞서 발생하며 잠재적 조기 발견의 지표가 될 수 있습니다.
암세포와 췌장 성상세포에서 분비된 엑소좀은 베타세포의 포도당 자극 인슐린 분비를 유의하게 억제했습니다.
해당 엑소좀은 간세포의 주요 인슐린 신호 전달 단백질(IR, IRS, AKT, FOXO1, GLUT2)을 감소시켰으며, 엑소좀 내 G6PD 침묵 시 신호가 부분적으로 회복되었습니다.
summary_ko: 췌장암 진단 수년 전에 선행하는 췌장암 관련 당뇨병(PCRD)의 발병 기전을 규명하기 위해 동물 및 세포 모델을 분석한 전임상 연구입니다. 고과당 식이를 섭취한 유전자 변형 생쥐 모델에서 성상세포(PSC) 활성화와 췌장암 전구 병변 진행, 포도당 내인성 장애가 확인되었습니다. 암세포 및 성상세포에서 분비된 엑소좀(exosome)은 췌장 베타세포의 인슐린 분비를 억제하고 간세포의 인슐린 신호 전달을 저해했습니다. 특히 엑소좀 내 포도당-6-인산탈수소효소(G6PD)를 억제했을 때 간세포 인슐린 신호 기능이 일부 회복됨을 확인했습니다.
title: Pancreatic cancer cell and stellate cell-derived exosome crosstalk mediates pancreatic cancer-related diabetes
title_ko: 췌장암 세포와 성상세포 유래 엑소좀 간의 상호작용이 매개하는 췌장암 관련 당뇨병
